# Nexus Flutter EPUB renderer fork

Source: https://pub.dev/api/archives/epub_view-3.3.0.tar.gz
Verified SHA256: 1e1c77ef7f455c75d77c84de42b3fcf6ec9066251072d4329988ce82513ab0d3
Original MIT license retained. Upstream example application omitted.

Changes:
- Resolve internal links relative to their source XHTML document, scoped to
  exact files and nested anchors, then navigate directly to paragraph indices.
- Depend on adjacent epubx fork using normal path dependency, no image override.
- Handle asynchronous load completion after route removal/disposal safely.
- Dispose loading notifier and unregister its view listener.
- Reuse typed image bytes, bound decoded image width to 1200 pixels, and
  gracefully handle missing/unsupported image data without fetching remotely.
- Evict this reader's own decoded images on disposal (not the app-wide cache).
- Optional native pagination: measure actual rendered lines/images, paginate
  one chapter at a time, cache that chapter's widgets across page turns, scale
  images to fit, and preserve a text-run/character anchor during reflow.
- Page arrows, horizontal swipes and keyboard navigation; chapter transitions
  evict the previous chapter's decoded images. Existing scrolling mode remains
  available to library callers, while NX Books opts into pagination.

This renderer lazily builds paragraphs, but still parses the complete book.
It does not provide a browser's full EPUB CSS/layout fidelity. CFI support is
paragraph-oriented and requires interoperability testing before source links
are generated by another engine. No KGQL or chapter-model logic belongs here.
